issue_request: FHIR-18450 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for STU3 asking to change the JSON page phrase "There are differences to XML" to "There are differences from XML".

additional_context: The comparison text was later moved from source/json.html into source/resource-formats.html by the FHIR-18452/FHIR-18448 change family, and FHIR-18449 updated the sentence to the clearer current wording "There are differences between XML and JSON." The resource-formats page is listed in source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, and source/json.html now links to resource-formats.html#comparison.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source already conveys the corrected meaning and does not contain the erroneous "to XML" wording.
